message:
In the 48-volt Lithium Iron Phosphate battery bank (Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4), long-life lithium chemistry) (C3), the ice-bank latent split has unquantified contribution problem. To check it I used whiteboard read-across of the autonomy check (E17). I found 11.25 Kilowatt-hours (Kilowatt-hour (kWh), energy unit) nominal with no separate ice Kilowatt-hours, according to Council Whiteboard, 2026. I propose Sam computes latent Kilowatt-hours for night cooling to close autonomy. My position: not ready because thermal ride-through cannot close on battery alone.

In the tilted-roof Photovoltaic array (Photovoltaic (PV), sunlight-to-electricity panels) (C2), the 4 Kilowatt upsizing approach has unchecked roof support problem. To check it I used standard off-grid review of the low-sun daily energy calc (E18). I found 3.75 Kilowatt-hours per day from 2 Kilowatts at 2 Peak Sun Hours (Peak Sun Hours (PSH), equivalent sun hours) versus 6.05 Kilowatt-hours load, according to DIY Eco Homes, 2024. I propose Maya checks roof weight, wind and shading for 4 Kilowatts before freezing size. My position: not ready because cloudy refill must be buildable.

Note on Sam: ice-bank quantification requested for autonomy split.
Note on Maya: roof check requested for upsized array.
